blocking_requirement: The requested 200k model must literally match deployed-100k normalization and geometry bounds while only the training population changes.

findings.finding: The training path unconditionally recomputes x/y mean-scale and geometry lower/upper arrays from the current train split.
Response-loss dimension weights are derived from current normalization and consumed with the current geometry envelope.
The parser exposes only normalization-floor and has no reference-normalization, geometry-envelope or dimension-weight artifact input.
Transported fine-tuning moves weights into current train-split normalization, ignores reference envelopes/weights, and changes the frozen random-initialization field.
Exact resume binds training data, normalization, initialization and arguments, so it rejects a population change.

array_identity.hash_method: SHA-256 of each little-endian float64 C-order array byte sequence

logical_conflict: Changing the training population changes the train-split values. The frozen trainer deterministically recomputes all seven arrays and exposes no native override. Reusing the 100k arrays would require changing trainer/wrapper behavior, changing training values rather than only their population, or changing initialization/transport semantics; each violates another frozen requirement.

decision_required.option_accept_existing: Accept method-identical population-refit normalization as the intended interpretation and retain the completed engineering diagnostic.
decision_required.option_new_contract: Authorize a different explicit fixed-normalization trainer contract and a new no-clobber run, acknowledging that this changes the implementation contract.
